name: IWA’s Survivor Series

date.source: The fed's own served broadcast opens: "Welcome to Survivor Series! Tonight, on April 18th, in San Antonio, Texas at the Alamodome, we're live!"

appearances.note: Dungeon of Doom lumberjack.
Degeneration-X lumberjack.

notes: The fed's own earliest-attested dated show. Four vacant titles are filled: Mr. Fro Chuck Brown and Mad Stoner win the Tag Team Titles from Triple H and Steel (a masked Sting factors into the finish); Freebird Michael Hayes submits Owen Hart for a non-title win; Mankind defeats Mad Stoner in a dumpster brawl for the Hardcore Title; DoggFather wins the Intercontinental Title from Mr. Fro Chuck Brown in a ladder match (two mystery men help DoggFather up the ladder); Degeneration-X (Freebird, Steel, Triple H, Rob Van Dam) defeats the Dungeon of Doom (Mankind, Stone Cold Steve Austin, Shawn Michaels, Sycho Sid) in a Hell in a Cell for the Stables Titles, Triple H and Steel handcuffing two Dungeon members to the cell first.

matches.note: For the vacant Tag Team Titles. A masked figure staged with Sting's own moveset (Scorpion Death Drop, Scorpion Death Lock, the trademark "WHOOOOOO") incapacitates both Triple H and Steel before Mad Stoner covers Triple H for the pin — the held record's text never confirms the figure's identity outright.
Won by submission (Iron Claw).
For the vacant Hardcore Title.
Dungeon of Doom (Mankind, Paul Wight, Shawn Michaels, Sycho Sid) and Degeneration-X (Triple H, Steel, Freebird Michael Hayes, Chyna) worked the lumberjack lines.
For the vacant Intercontinental Title. Badd Ass Billy Gunn and Roaddogg Jesse James run in to revive DoggFather and hold Mr. Fro Chuck Brown back as DoggFather climbs for the belt.
For the vacant Stables Titles. Triple H and Steel handcuff Stone Cold Steve Austin and Mankind to the cell before Rob Van Dam pins a knocked-out Mankind.

Fast-counted Corporate-SDH's win over Ringmaster and worked special guest referee for the World Title main event; announced from backstage that every title but the Online belt was on the line.
Sneaks into the ring to hit Turney with a Crotch Chop during the Stables Titles match.

Guest commentator for the broadcast’s final part, brought out by Natedogg.
Guest commentator for the broadcast’s final part, brought out by Natedogg.

notes: Freebird Michael Hayes retains the Hardcore Title over Taz (loser-leaves-fed; Taz passes out to the Iron Claw). Shawn Michaels and Orge Lambart win the Tag Team Titles from Mr. Fro Chuck Brown and Mad Stoner (a fan-interference assist). Stone Cold Steve Austin defeats Ringmaster for an Online Title shot. Degeneration-X's own Ringmaster/Turney/Big Man Turney combination factors into a Stables-Titles-adjacent brawl. New Jack falls to Shawn Michaels in a "Gangsta's Paradise" match. Corporate-SDH (Steel, Fro, President NateDogg) wins the Stables Titles. Raven retains the European Title over X-Pac. In the main event, Sting dethrones champion Triple H for the IWA World Title inside a steel cage, President NateDogg working as special guest referee and counting the pin himself.

matches.note: For the Hardcore Title. Freebird wins by passout (Iron Claw); Triple H runs in afterward and beats Freebird down with a chair.
For the Tag Team Titles. A fan pulls Orge Lambart to the ropes and hits Mad Stoner with a foreign object before Orge rolls Stoner up for the pin.
Winner to receive an Online Title shot. Shawn Michaels runs in with Sweet Chin Music before Big Man Turney chases him off and helps Austin recover for the Stunner.
Won by pinfall (Sweet Chin Music).

For the Stables Titles. President NateDogg emerges from a trap door, chairs Triple H, then fast-counts Ringmaster himself after Corporate-SDH's Mr. Fro Chuck Brown and Mad Stoner take out Orge Lambart.
For the European Title. Raven hits the Evenflow through a table for the pin.
For the Intercontinental Title. Steel hits Death From Above twice for the pin.
For the Cruiserweight Title. X-Pac pins HBK with the X-Factor.

For the World Title, President NateDogg working as special guest referee. Triple H attacks NateDogg before the cage locks; Sting drops from the cage roof and pins Triple H after the Scorpion Death Drop and Scorpion Death Lock.

name: IWA’s Saturday Night Massacre

date.source: The fed's own vault filename (81499.html) and its own recurring "Saturday Night Massacre" branding, corroborated by a later house show's own forward schedule naming the same recurring Saturday slot.

appearances.note: Knocked out by a masked Raditz before his own billed European Title challenge could start.
Interfered in the Intercontinental Title match, warning Raven, "I'm coming after you and that IC title!"

notes: A mystery masked man drops from the ceiling to attack both Chaos (defending the European Title against Unforgiven) and Unforgiven, revealing himself minutes later as Raditz. O.G. Chunk wins the Hardcore Title in a four-corners scramble (Lex Luger, Hardcore Tom, Canyon), Raditz clearing three of the four men first. Raven retains the Intercontinental Title over Ringmaster (Ravens Rules), Sid and Raditz both factoring into the finish; Raven names Raditz his new "right hand man" before Chaos runs in on both of them. The broadcast's own commentary bills Shawn Michaels defending "his World Title" against Turney as the show's main event — a title-context claim the surviving transcript does not itself stage or resolve. The document's own outbound link to a second part (results/815992.html) is not present anywhere in the vault mirror — a genuine dead link, not a filing gap.

matches.note: Billed as Unforgiven challenging Chaos for the European Title; a masked Raditz knocks Unforgiven out cold before the bell and wrestles Chaos himself, winning the title with the Krionic Kick.
For the Hardcore Title. Canyon eliminates Luger on the entrance ramp and platform; O.G. Chunk powerbombs Hardcore Tom through a table, then wears Canyon down with a Singapore cane for the finish.

For the Intercontinental Title. Sycho Sid breaks up a Raven cover with a chokeslam and powerbomb before leaving; a masked Raditz pulls Ringmaster out of a near-fall cover and hits the Krionic Kick, letting Raven retain. Raven names Raditz his new "right hand man" before Chaos runs in and bulldogs them both.

name: IWA’s Barbed Wire

date.source: No exact date survives on the document itself; its own filename pairs it with the held record's other August 1999 content, chronologically after the 14 August "Saturday Night Massacre" (O.G. Chunk, this show's own deposed Hardcore Champion, is billed there as the reigning champion first).

appearances.note: Accompanied Raditz and factored into his Hardcore Title win.
Ran in for O.G. Chunk and was knocked out by Nappa.
Interfered twice — a Crotch Chop on Turney in the Tag Team Titles match, then an accidental chair shot on Triple H in the Stables Titles match.
Announced the World Title main event.

notes: Part 1: Chaos retains the Cruiserweight Title by no-show (Jeff Halesz and Hardcore Tom both fail to appear); Freebird Michael Hayes retains the European Title by no-show (Death Angel fails to appear); Raditz (with Nappa) wins the Hardcore Title from O.G. Chunk; Freebird and Triple H win the vacant Tag Team Titles over Turney and Stone Cold Steve Austin. Part 2: Sycho Sid wins the Intercontinental Title (O.G. Chunk pulled for injury, leaving a singles match with Chaos); Degeneration-X (Triple H, Shawn Michaels, Freebird) challenges Turney's own "nWo Turney" stable (Turney, Stone Cold Steve Austin, Teen) for the Stables Titles. The IWA World Title changes hands in the main event: Canyon defeats Turney after two masked men run in, revealed afterward as Chaos and Shawn Michaels — Turney grabs a microphone and declares himself "screwed" before leaving.

matches.note: For the Hardcore Title. Nappa and Big E both run in for their partners; Raditz pins O.G. Chunk with the Unknown Power.

For the vacant Tag Team Titles, Turney and Stone Cold Steve Austin billed as former champions. Chyna hits Turney with a Crotch Chop and, later, drags Austin's leg as Freebird covers Turney for the pin.
For the Intercontinental Title, O.G. Chunk pulled from the scheduled three-way by injury.
For the Stables Titles. Chyna's chair shot meant for Turney instead knocks out Triple H after Turney ducks; Turney elevates Triple H with the Turney Bomb for the pin.

For the World Title. Two masked men interfere — revealed afterward as Chaos and Shawn Michaels — the second superkicking Turney so Canyon can cover for the pin. Turney declares himself "screwed" and leaves.
